- Show live latency/cost dashboards for a sample workload

Are you available this week for a short demo? Here are a couple slots I have free:
- Thu 4/16 11:00–11:30am PT

If those don't work you can pick a time on my calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/marcus/15

Cheers,

marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127
